Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Relied on search-result snippets instead of opening and extracting authoritative content, surfacing a misleading claim that “oxygen” is fungi’s energy source. This ineffective sourcing and lack of progression (repeating similar searches without clicking through or quoting credible pages) risked steering the solution toward the wrong option and impeded a clear, evidence-based conclusion.
